# RAG Test Document: Fictional Company "Aurelia Robotics"

This document is designed for testing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. It contains distinct, verifiable facts spread across sections, tables, lists, and nested headings, so you can test chunking boundaries, retrieval precision, and answer grounding.

## 1. Company Overview

Aurelia Robotics was founded in 2014 in Porto, Portugal. The company specializes in autonomous warehouse robots and currently employs 342 people across three offices: Porto, Austin, and Singapore.

The current CEO is Marta Silveira, who took over in 2019 after the departure of founder Diego Ferreira. Ferreira remains on the board as Chairman.

## 2. Products

### 2.1 Falcon-9X Warehouse Robot

- **Release year:** 2021
- **Max payload:** 450 kg
- **Battery life:** 14 hours continuous operation
- **Price:** $38,500 per unit

### 2.2 Sparrow Mini

- **Release year:** 2023
- **Max payload:** 60 kg
- **Battery life:** 22 hours continuous operation
- **Price:** $9,200 per unit

### 2.3 Discontinued: Kestrel Line

The Kestrel line was discontinued in 2020 due to a critical hinge defect discovered in 1,200 units. All affected customers received a full refund totaling approximately $4.1 million.

Aurelia Robotics went through a Series C funding round in March 2022, raising $30 million led by Northbridge Ventures.

## 4. Key Personnel

1. **Marta Silveira** — CEO, joined 2019
2. **Rahul Deshpande** — CTO, joined 2015, previously worked at Boston Dynamics
3. **Elena Kovač** — CFO, joined 2020
4. **Tomás Reis** — VP of Manufacturing, joined 2016

## 5. Manufacturing Locations

The Falcon-9X is manufactured exclusively at the Porto facility. The Sparrow Mini is manufactured in a leased facility in Guadalajara, Mexico, opened in 2023 to reduce shipping costs to North American customers.

## 6. Customer Support Policy

Aurelia Robotics offers a standard 2-year warranty on all robots. Extended warranties can be purchased for an additional 3 years at 15% of the unit's purchase price per year. Support tickets are answered within 24 hours on weekdays and 48 hours on weekends.

## 7. Notable Incident

In July 2022, a software bug caused 40 Falcon-9X units at a single client site in Rotterdam to collide with warehouse shelving. No injuries were reported. The bug was traced to a faulty firmware update (version 3.2.1) and was patched within 72 hours.

## 8. Trivia Section (edge-case retrieval test)

- The mascot of Aurelia Robotics is a stylized falcon named "Rook."
- The company's internal Slack has a channel called #robot-graveyard for retired prototype names.
- Aurelia's headquarters building was previously a textile factory built in 1932.

# Company 2: Halcyon Dynamics (Similar to Aurelia Robotics — Direct Competitor)

## 9. Company Overview

Halcyon Dynamics was founded in 2016 in Eindhoven, Netherlands. Like Aurelia Robotics, it builds autonomous warehouse robots, making it a direct competitor. The company employs 298 people across two offices: Eindhoven and Atlanta.

The current CEO is Jasper Van Doorn, who has held the role since founding the company. There has been no change in leadership since inception.

## 10. Products

### 10.1 Griffin-7 Warehouse Robot

- **Release year:** 2020
- **Max payload:** 500 kg
- **Battery life:** 12 hours continuous operation
- **Price:** $41,000 per unit

### 10.2 Wren Compact

- **Release year:** 2022
- **Max payload:** 55 kg
- **Battery life:** 20 hours continuous operation
- **Price:** $8,700 per unit

Halcyon Dynamics has never discontinued a product line since its founding.

## 11. Financial Summary

| Year | Revenue (USD) | Net Profit (USD) | Employees |
|------|---------------|-------------------|-----------|
| 2021 | 15.0 million  | 0.6 million       | 190       |
| 2022 | 22.4 million  | 2.1 million       | 240       |
| 2023 | 34.9 million  | 5.0 million       | 275       |
| 2024 | 47.6 million  | 7.8 million       | 298       |

Halcyon Dynamics raised $22 million in a Series B round in September 2021, led by Delta Capital Partners.

## 12. Key Personnel

1. **Jasper Van Doorn** — CEO and Founder
2. **Priya Nair** — CTO, joined 2017, previously worked at KUKA Robotics
3. **Lukas Bergmann** — CFO, joined 2019

## 13. Notable Incident

In 2023, a batch of 15 Griffin-7 units shipped to a client in Lyon experienced sensor drift after a firmware update (version 2.4.0), causing minor collisions with pallets. No injuries occurred. The issue was resolved within 96 hours.

# Company 3: Cedarwood & Finch (Different from Aurelia Robotics — Artisanal Furniture Maker)

## 14. Company Overview

Cedarwood & Finch is a furniture design and manufacturing company founded in 2009 in Asheville, North Carolina. Unlike Aurelia Robotics and Halcyon Dynamics, it has no connection to robotics — it specializes in handcrafted wooden furniture. The company employs 87 people, all at a single workshop and showroom location.

The current CEO is Owen Bramblett, who co-founded the company with his sister, Clara Bramblett, who serves as Head of Design.

## 15. Products

### 15.1 The Ashgrove Dining Table

- **Release year:** 2011
- **Material:** Solid white oak
- **Price:** $3,200
- **Lead time:** 8 weeks

### 15.2 The Wickham Rocking Chair

- **Release year:** 2015
- **Material:** Black walnut
- **Price:** $890
- **Lead time:** 4 weeks

### 15.3 Discontinued: The Fernhollow Bookshelf

The Fernhollow Bookshelf was discontinued in 2019 after customers reported warping in humid climates. Approximately 340 units were affected, and the company offered store credit rather than refunds.

## 16. Financial Summary

| Year | Revenue (USD) | Net Profit (USD) | Employees |
|------|---------------|-------------------|-----------|
| 2021 | 4.8 million   | 0.5 million       | 62        |
| 2022 | 5.9 million   | 0.7 million       | 71        |
| 2023 | 7.1 million   | 1.0 million       | 80        |
| 2024 | 8.4 million   | 1.3 million       | 87        |

Cedarwood & Finch has never raised outside venture funding; it has been fully self-financed since 2009.

## 17. Key Personnel

1. **Owen Bramblett** — CEO and Co-Founder
2. **Clara Bramblett** — Head of Design and Co-Founder
3. **Marcus Whitfield** — Operations Manager, joined 2013

## 18. Notable Incident

In 2020, a shipment delay caused by a supplier shortage of black walnut lumber pushed Wickham Rocking Chair lead times to 14 weeks for three months. The company issued a 10% discount to affected customers as compensation.
